current_answer: Choose by task. For a new company or marketing site, Taste Skill v2.5.1 is a conditional trial if you can run its Node and Chrome checks and accept its strong layout and motion defaults. For an existing app screen, Improve UI is a conditional read-only audit; it does not edit product source. For file review, Web Design Guidelines requires a rule fetch and revision record.
